verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is the Sandbox guide (paxos-docs-50), which says developers can create deposit addresses that receive testnet assets onto the Paxos platform. This implies programmatic deposit-address provisioning, but nothing in the pack shows per-customer or per-purpose wallet creation. Identity onboarding (paxos-docs-5, paxos-docs-6) covers creating customer identities, not wallets, so it earns no credit here. Missing for 10: documented API for creating per-customer/per-purpose wallets or sub-accounts, a production deposit-address endpoint reference, documented key custody semantics, and independent corroboration.
